Name: Clint Lite Portrait - Vanilla Style Seasonal Portraits and Sprites
Author: LeelooStardew
Description:
Clint "Lite" gives Clint a slimmer, more muscular look with new seasonal and festival portraits and sprites. 

Formerly known as Handsome Clint. After a few Ozempic jokes, I figured a little rebranding was in order.

This is only a visual replacer. It does not change any dialogue, events, etc. I recommend [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15830]Clint Rewritten[/url] for that.

[b]Compatible with:[/b]
[list]
[*]Seasonal Outfits Slightly Cuter Aesthetic: Just disable Clint in that mod's config. Handsome Clint has its own seasonal outfits.[/*]
[*]Clint Rewritten [/*]
[*]Clint Narrative Overhaul[/*]
[*]Clint Reforged [/*]
[*]Looking For Love Redux[/*]
[*]SVE[/*]
[*]PolyamorySweet[/*]
[*]Hugs and Kisses[/*]
[*]Free Love[/*]
[/list]
❌ Not Compatible:  Cocky Clint

Note: Hugs and Kisses Continued appears to be broken for Clint, but I found that you can fix it by overriding his kiss frame by adding Clint:38 to CustomKissFrames in that mod's config.json. Like this: "CustomKissFrames": "Sam:36,Penny:35,Clint:38",

When 1.7 releases, I’ll do my best to make sure the mod is fully updated and compatible! 💗
